user.title: Connect to ENGIE Italia
user.description: Connect your electricity and gas supplies in read-only mode. This unofficial integration never asks for your ENGIE password.

api_setup.title: Prepare the connection
api_setup.description: This assisted beta requires a privately supplied API key for the initial connection. This is not your ENGIE password. If no key is available, cancel setup: independent public setup is not supported yet.

oauth.name: Advanced OAuth settings
oauth.description: Leave the default unchanged unless using a separately provisioned client.

authorize.title: Sign in to ENGIE
authorize.description:
[Open the ENGIE sign-in page]({authorization_url})

Complete sign-in and any verification code on the ENGIE website. Then copy the complete final address from the browser and paste it below, even if the return page is blank or shows an error.

ENGIE does not yet allow an automatic return to Home Assistant. Complete this step within 10 minutes and do not share the address: it contains a temporary code. Future session renewals are automatic while ENGIE permits them.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to ENGIE again
reauth_confirm.description: ENGIE requires a new sign-in. Your API connection is already configured. Continue using the same ENGIE account as before.

error.invalid_auth: Authorization failed or expired. A new sign-in is required.
error.cannot_connect: ENGIE is unavailable. Try signing in again later.
error.storage_error: The session could not be saved. Retry saving without signing in again.

abort.wrong_account: The selected account does not match the existing integration.
